reviewer_script_source:
"""Compare this rerun with previously reviewed, identical synthetic translations."""

import copy
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "carebridge-ai"
report_raw = (root / "evaluation/spec-gpu-v9.json").read_bytes()
report = json.loads(report_raw)
prior_raw = (root / "evaluation/spec-reference-review-v7.json").read_bytes()
prior = json.loads(prior_raw)
prior_cases = {r["id"]: r for r in prior["cases"]}
old_report_raw = (root / "evaluation/spec-gpu-v7.json").read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(old_report_raw).hexdigest() == prior["evaluation_sha256"]
old_report = json.loads(old_report_raw)
old_entries = {r["id"]: r for r in old_report["translations"]}
corpus_raw = (root / "evaluation/translation-corpus-v5.json").read_bytes()
corpus = json.loads(corpus_raw)
cases = {c["id"]: c for c in corpus["translation_cases"]}
assert hashlib.sha256(corpus_raw).hexdigest() == report["corpus_sha256"] == prior["corpus_sha256"]
rows, changed = [], []
identical_count = 0
for entry in report["translations"]:
    cid = entry["id"]
    old, c = prior_cases[cid], cases[cid]
    assert old["source"] == c["source"] and old["reference"] == c["reference"]
    assert old["required_facts"] == c["required_facts"]
    assert old["translation"] == old_entries[cid]["response"]["translation"]["text"]
    result = entry["response"]
    if entry["http_status"] != 200:
        row = copy.deepcopy(old)
        row.update(translation=None, http_status=entry["http_status"], qa_status=None,
                   grade="unavailable", dimensions=["generation_error"],
                   comment="No successful translation response in this run; do not reuse earlier quality findings.",
                   actual_confirmation_segments=None, actual_categories=None)
        rows.append(row)
        continue
    assert result["source"]["text"] == c["source"]
    assert entry["source_evidence_valid"] and entry["sharing_blocked"], cid
    if result["translation"] != old_entries[cid]["response"]["translation"]:
        changed.append({"id": cid, "source": c["source"], "reference": c["reference"], "previous": old["translation"], "current": result["translation"]["text"]})
        continue
    row = copy.deepcopy(old)
    row["qa_status"] = result["status"]
    ids = [s["evidence"]["segment_id"] for s in result["translation"]["segments"]]
    row["actual_confirmation_segments"] = [ids.index(s["evidence"]["segment_id"]) for s in result["additional_checks"]]
    row["actual_categories"] = [s["category"] for s in result["observations"]]
    rows.append(row)
    identical_count += 1

print(json.dumps({"finished": bool(report.get("finished_at")), "translations": len(report["translations"]), "exact_translation_matches": identical_count, "failed_requests": [{"id":r["id"],"http_status":r["http_status"]} for r in rows if r["grade"]=="unavailable"], "changed_translations": changed}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
if "--write" not in sys.argv:
    sys.exit(0)
assert report.get("finished_at"), "Wait for the complete evaluation"
assert not changed, "Changed translations require separate source comparison"
assert len(rows) == len(cases) == 75
assert set(report["code_sha256"]) == {p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in (root / "app").rglob("*.py")}
for path, digest in report["code_sha256"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, path

def summarize(items):
    out = dict(Counter(r["grade"] for r in items))
    out.update(
        major_held=sum(r["grade"] == "major" and r["qa_status"] == "hold" for r in items),
        major_not_held=sum(r["grade"] == "major" and r["qa_status"] != "hold" for r in items),
        clean_or_minor_held=sum(r["grade"] in ("clean", "minor") and r["qa_status"] == "hold" for r in items),
        confirmation_disagreements=[r["id"] for r in items if r["actual_confirmation_segments"] is not None and r["actual_confirmation_segments"] != r["expected_confirmation_segments"]],
        category_disagreements=[r["id"] for r in items if r["actual_categories"] is not None and any(c not in r["expected_category_set"] for c in r["actual_categories"])],
    )
    return out

snapshot = json.dumps(report["translations"], ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
review = dict(
    schema="carebridge.spec-reference-review.v1",
    review_date_kst=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=9))).date().isoformat(),
    reviewer="coding assistant; not a native-speaking human reviewer",
    method="Reuse prior language annotations only for exactly identical source/reference/fact fields and complete translation objects. Mark failed generation requests unavailable; recompute QA status, confirmation and category differences for successful responses. Repeated synthetic development cases; not independent, native-speaker, clinical or field validation.",
    corpus_sha256=hashlib.sha256(corpus_raw).hexdigest(),
    evaluation_sha256=hashlib.sha256(report_raw).hexdigest(),
    evaluation_complete=True,
    translation_snapshot_sha256=hashlib.sha256(snapshot).hexdigest(),
    previous_review_sha256=hashlib.sha256(prior_raw).hexdigest(),
    reviewer_script_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    reviewer_script_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
    exact_translation_matches=identical_count,
    summary=summarize(rows),
    cohorts={name: summarize([r for r in rows if r["cohort"] == name]) for name in prior["cohorts"]},
    cases=rows,
)
with (root / "evaluation/spec-reference-review-v9.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
    json.dump(review, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    f.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(review["summary"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
